actions.description: UE transmits REGISTRATION REQUEST message to AMF

excerpts: The UE initiates the registration procedure for initial registration by sending a REGISTRATION REQUEST message to the AMF, starting timer T3510.

actions.description: UE stops timer T3502 if running

excerpts: If timer T3502 is currently running, the UE shall stop timer T3502.

actions.description: UE stops timer T3511 if running

excerpts: If timer T3511 is currently running, the UE shall stop timer T3511.

actions.description: UE starts timer T3519 if SUCI is included and T3519 is not running

excerpts: If the SUCI is included in the 5GS mobile identity IE and the timer T3519 is not running, the UE shall start timer T3519 and store the value of the SUCI sent in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

actions.description: UE includes stored SUCI in REGISTRATION REQUEST while T3519 is running

excerpts: The UE shall include the stored SUCI in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message while timer T3519 is running.

actions.description: UE includes entire REGISTRATION REQUEST in NAS message container IE of SECURITY MODE COMPLETE if no valid 5G NAS security context

excerpts: If the UE does not have a valid 5G NAS security context, the UE shall send the REGISTRATION REQUEST message without including the NAS message container IE. The UE shall include the entire REGISTRATION REQUEST message (i.e. containing cleartext IEs and non-cleartext IEs, if any) in the NAS message container IE that is sent as part of the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message as described in subclauses 4.4.6 and 5.4.2.3.

actions.description: UE includes NAS message container IE in REGISTRATION REQUEST if valid 5G NAS security context and non-cleartext IEs need to be sent

excerpts: If the UE has a valid 5G NAS security context and the UE needs to send non-cleartext IEs, the UE shall send a REGISTRATION REQUEST message including the NAS message container IE as described in subclause 4.4.6.

actions.description: UE sends REGISTRATION REQUEST without NAS message container IE if no non-cleartext IEs need to be sent and valid 5G NAS security context

excerpts: If the UE does not need to send non-cleartext IEs, the UE shall send a REGISTRATION REQUEST message without including the NAS message container IE.

actions.description: UE sets the S1 mode bit to "S1 mode supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message

excerpts: If the UE supports S1 mode and the UE has not disabled its E-UTRA capability and the 5GS registration type IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message is not set to "disaster roaming initial registration", the UE shall: - set the S1 mode bit to "S1 mode supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message;

actions.description: UE includes the S1 UE network capability IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message

excerpts: If the UE supports S1 mode and the UE has not disabled its E-UTRA capability and the 5GS registration type IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message is not set to "disaster roaming initial registration", the UE shall: - include the S1 UE network capability IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message; additionally, if the UE supports EPS-UPIP, the UE shall set the EPS-UPIP bit to "EPS-UPIP supported" in the S1 UE network capability IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message; and

actions.description: UE sets the HO attach bit to "attach request message containing PDN connectivity request with request type set to handover to transfer PDU session from N1 mode to S1 mode supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message

excerpts: If the UE supports S1 mode and the UE has not disabled its E-UTRA capability and the 5GS registration type IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message is not set to "disaster roaming initial registration", the UE shall: - if the UE supports sending an ATTACH REQUEST message containing a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message with request type set to "handover" to transfer a PDU session from N1 mode to S1 mode, set the HO attach bit to "attach request message containing PDN connectivity request with request type set to handover to transfer PDU session from N1 mode to S1 mode supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

actions.description: UE enters state 5GMM-REGISTERED and sets the 5GS update status to 5U1 UPDATED upon receipt of REGISTRATION ACCEPT

excerpts: Upon receipt of the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message, the UE shall reset the registration attempt counter, enter state 5GMM-REGISTERED and set the 5GS update status to 5U1 UPDATED.

actions.description: UE uses the value in the T3512 value IE as periodic registration update timer (T3512) if REGISTRATION ACCEPT message included a T3512 value IE

excerpts: If the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message included a T3512 value IE, the UE shall use the value in the T3512 value IE as periodic registration update timer (T3512).

actions.description: UE uses the value in the T3324 value IE as active timer (T3324) if REGISTRATION ACCEPT message included a T3324 value IE

excerpts: If the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message include a T3324 value IE, the UE shall use the value in the T3324 value IE as active timer (T3324).

actions.description: UE uses the value in non-3GPP de-registration timer value IE as non-3GPP de-registration timer if REGISTRATION ACCEPT message included a non-3GPP de-registration timer value IE

excerpts: If the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message included a non-3GPP de-registration timer value IE, the UE shall use the value in non-3GPP de-registration timer value IE as non-3GPP de-registration timer.

actions.description: UE returns a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge the successful update of the network slicing information

excerpts: the UE shall return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge the successful update of the network slicing information.

actions.description: UE returns REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge the reception of the NSAG information IE

excerpts: the UE shall return REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge the reception of the NSAG information IE.

actions.description: UE returns REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge reception of the operator-defined access category definitions, the extended local emergency numbers list or the "CAG information list"

excerpts: the UE shall return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge reception of the operator-defined access category definitions, the extended local emergency numbers list or the "CAG information list".

actions.description: UE returns REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge the reception of the Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE

excerpts: the UE shall return REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge the reception of the Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE.

actions.description: UE returns a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge reception of the UE radio capability ID IE or the UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE

excerpts: the UE shall return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge reception of the UE radio capability ID IE or the UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE.
ies: UE radio capability ID deletion indication

actions.description: UE returns a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge reception of the truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration

excerpts: the UE shall store the included truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration and return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge reception of the truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration.

actions.description: UE returns a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge reception of the service-level-AA pending indication

excerpts: the UE shall return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge reception of the service-level-AA pending indication

actions.description: UE enters state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION over non-3GPP access and set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED over non-3GPP access

excerpts: if in 5GMM-REGISTERED state over non-3GPP access and on the same PLMN or SNPN as 3GPP access, shall enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION over non-3GPP access and set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED over non-3GPP access

actions.description: UE enters state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION over 3GPP access and set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED over 3GPP access

excerpts: if in the 5GMM-REGISTERED state over 3GPP access and is on the same PLMN or SNPN as non-3GPP access, shall enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION over 3GPP access and set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED over 3GPP access
